# ccp_machine_test

Monorepo for standalone tools the agent harness can use, one npm workspace per tool under `packages/`.
Every tool is Node.js (22+) or Bun, plain ES modules, with no build step and no runtime dependencies.

The harness itself lives in `suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine`: `packages/harness` (the spec in
`packages/harness/spec/` is the source of truth for behaviour), `packages/ledger`, the `plugins/harness`
plugin and the `mods/harness-status` mod. They moved there on 2026-10-27 from commit `1244253` of this
repo. Nothing here is cloned or loaded by the harness at runtime.

## What is here

- No tools yet: `packages/` is empty, and `npm test` says so and passes.
- `canary/last.txt`: the file the harness's daily tier-0 canary item bumps through a PR, CI and merge.
- `plugins/harness/skills/orchestrator/`: the parked orchestrator skill. Its prose drifted from the
  machines, so it is not in the plugin; it comes back only once it is derived from them again.

## Commands

From the repo root: `npm ci`, then `npm test` (every workspace's `node:test` suite).

result.builder:
Build a new tool, jsonl-lint, as a workspace under packages/jsonl-lint, and open one pull request that meets every acceptance line of https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test/issues/102. At present packages/ does not exist; the root package.json already lists packages/* as workspaces; .github/workflows/test.yml runs `npm ci` then `npm test` on Node 22.

Steps:
1. Create packages/jsonl-lint/package.json with name `jsonl-lint`, `"type": "module"`, `"scripts": { "test": "node --test" }`, a `bin` entry `{ "jsonl-lint": "bin/jsonl-lint.js" }`, engines node >=22, and no `dependencies` (no devDependencies either; use only node: built-ins).
2. Create packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js, a plain ES module that exports `lint(text)`. Split text on `\n` (strip a trailing `\r` per line so CRLF works). Line numbers are 1-based. Skip lines that are empty or only whitespace. JSON.parse every other line, including a last line with no terminating newline (a torn/unterminated last row must be checked, not dropped). Return an array of `{ line, error }` objects, one per invalid row, in order, where error is the parse error message; return [] when all rows are valid. A trailing newline at the end of the file must not produce an error.
3. Create packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js with a `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang (make it executable, git mode 100755). It takes one file argument. With no argument, print a usage message to stderr and exit 2. If the file cannot be read (missing), print an error to stderr and exit 2. Otherwise read it as UTF-8, run lint, print `<file>:<line>: <error>` (the file as given on the command line) to stdout for each invalid row, and exit 1 if there were any, 0 if none.
4. Write node:test tests in packages/jsonl-lint/test/ (e.g. test/lint.test.js and test/cli.test.js) that `node --test` picks up from the workspace directory. Cover: a clean file (no errors, CLI exit 0); a bad middle row (reports exactly that line number, CLI prints `<file>:<line>: ` and exits 1); a torn last row with no trailing newline (reported); blank lines (skipped, and line numbers of later rows still count them); the exit codes 0, 1 and 2 (no argument, missing file), running the bin with child_process.spawnSync(process.execPath, [binPath, ...]) and temp files from fs.mkdtempSync(os.tmpdir()).
5. Create packages/jsonl-lint/README.md: what it does, usage `jsonl-lint <file>`, output format, exit codes 0/1/2, and the `lint(text)` API.
6. Update the root README.md: replace the "No tools yet" bullet in "What is here" with a bullet listing `packages/jsonl-lint` and a one-line description.
7. Run `npm install` at the repo root so package-lock.json includes the new workspace (otherwise `npm ci` in CI fails), and commit the updated package-lock.json. Then run `npm ci && npm test` at the root and confirm it passes, and run `node packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js` by hand against a clean file, a bad file, a missing file and no argument to see output and exit codes.
8. Commit everything and open one PR on suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test whose body contains the line `Closes https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test/issues/102`. Wait for the `test` workflow on the PR head to finish; if it fails, read the log, fix, push, and repeat until it is green.
result.verifier:
Check out the pull request's head. Run every check there. Work in a temp dir (mktemp -d) for test fixtures. Give one PASS or FAIL per check, with the evidence (commands and output).

Check 1 — expect: "packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js <file> prints <file>:<line>: <error> for every row that is not valid JSON (1-based lines, blank lines skipped, an unterminated last line checked) and exits 1 if any, 0 if none".
Run: create clean.jsonl with `{"a":1}\n{"b":2}\n`; create bad.jsonl with `{"a":1}\n\n{bad\n{"c":3}\n{"torn":` (no trailing newline; line 2 blank, line 3 bad, line 5 unterminated). Run `node packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js <tmp>/clean.jsonl; echo $?` and the same for bad.jsonl.
PASS: clean prints no error rows and exits 0; bad prints a line starting `<tmp>/bad.jsonl:3: ` followed by an error text and a line starting `<tmp>/bad.jsonl:5: ` followed by an error text, no row for lines 1, 2 or 4, and exits 1.
FAIL: any other exit code, a missing row for line 3 or 5, a wrong line number, an error reported for the blank line or a valid row, or rows not in the `<file>:<line>: <error>` form.

Check 2 — expect: "A missing file or no argument prints to stderr and exits 2".
Run: `node packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js <tmp>/nope.jsonl >out 2>err; echo $?` and `node packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js >out 2>err; echo $?`, inspecting err each time.
PASS: both exit 2 and both write non-empty output to stderr.
FAIL: either exits other than 2, or its stderr is empty.

Check 3 — expect: "packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js exports lint(text) returning [{ line, error }]".
Run: `node --input-type=module -e "import {lint} from './packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js'; console.log(JSON.stringify(lint('{\"a\":1}\n{bad\n')), JSON.stringify(lint('{\"a\":1}\n')))"`.
PASS: lint is an exported function; the first result is an array containing an object with `line` equal to 2 and an `error` property; the second is an empty array.
FAIL: import fails, lint is not exported, it returns something other than an array, or items lack `line` or `error`.

Check 4 — expect: "The workspace has its own package.json (jsonl-lint, type module, test script node --test), no runtime dependencies, and node:test tests for a clean file, a bad middle row, a torn last row, blank lines and the exit codes".
Run: read packages/jsonl-lint/package.json; read the test files under packages/jsonl-lint; run `npm test --workspace jsonl-lint` (or `cd packages/jsonl-lint && npm test`).
PASS: package.json has name `jsonl-lint`, type `module`, scripts.test is `node --test`, and no non-empty `dependencies`; the tests use node:test and include cases for a clean file, a bad middle row, a torn last row, blank lines, and the exit codes; the workspace tests pass.
FAIL: any of those fields is wrong or missing, there are runtime dependencies, one of the five named cases has no test, or the tests fail.

Check 5 — expect: "packages/jsonl-lint/README.md exists and the root README lists the tool".
Run: `test -f packages/jsonl-lint/README.md && echo ok`; `grep -n jsonl-lint README.md`.
PASS: the file exists and the root README.md mentions jsonl-lint as a tool.
FAIL: the file is missing or the root README does not list it.

Check 6 — expect: "The change is one PR on suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test whose body says Closes https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test/issues/102, and npm test and the test workflow are green at its head".
Run: `gh pr view <pr> --repo suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test --json body,headRefOid,state`; `gh pr checks <pr> --repo suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test`; at the head run `npm ci && npm test`.
PASS: the PR is on suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test, its body contains `Closes https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test/issues/102`, the `test` workflow check at the head commit succeeded, and `npm ci && npm test` passes locally.
FAIL: the body lacks that text, the test check is failing, pending or absent at the head, or npm test fails.

Advisory (not pass/fail):
- Check that package-lock.json was updated to include the workspace; `npm ci` fails otherwise.
- Check that CRLF input does not produce false errors, that a file ending in a newline gives no error for the empty final line, and that bin/jsonl-lint.js has a shebang and executable mode.
- Check the error rows go to stdout and that exit 2 cases print nothing to stdout.
